messages:
deploybot: rollback initiated for service=runtime environment=prod-usw. Trigger: kv-cache miss spike + 99p latency >1200ms observed during canary. Rolling back to tag v2026.03.10-stable (commit a1b2c3d). Rollout strategy: immediate, initial 25% traffic replaced. Reason: regressions in KV cache optimization. RB ticket RB-4591 created.

alice.chen: ack. Thanks for the heads up. Is the pin automatic or do we need to pin manually?

raj.patel: I'll pin and coordinate. Running pin command now.

raj.patel: ran: `./deployctl pin --env prod-usw --tag v2026.03.10-stable --reason "rollback kv-cache regression"`

sre-oncall: noted. I'll watch the circuit-breakers and make sure we have capacity in other regions in case of failover.

carla: can we route EU traffic away from the affected worker pool until we confirm stability?

deploybot: rollback in progress: replacing containers on 8 nodes (prod-usw). Rolling back model runtime image from v2026.03.15 -> v2026.03.10-stable. Estimated duration 3-6 minutes. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/2323456789/logs

deploybot: rollback completed. Active tag now v2026.03.10-stable (pinned). All prod-usw instances replaced, canary aborted. Duration: 3m12s. No deploy errors recorded. RB-4591 updated with logs.

alice.chen: verified basic health: 5xx error rate back to baseline, 99p latency ~180ms. :thumbsup:

raj.patel: adding release note: "Reverted runtime to v2026.03.10 due to KV-cache regression detected in v2026.03.15 during canary. Rolling back while we investigate cache behavior. Hotfix plan: reproduce locally, revert KV cache optimization, re-run extended canary."

carla: opening infra ticket and assigning to @raj.patel and @sre-oncall. Tagging postmortem.

deploybot: pin applied: v2026.03.10-stable -> permanent pin until hotfix release. Rollback ticket RB-4591. Monitoring keepalive set for 1h.

jordan: noted — we have the change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC; do not re-release until postmortem and signoff.

sre-oncall: setting alert guardrails back to pre-release thresholds. Will close this thread after 1h if stable.

raj.patel: quick diff for context: `git show --name-only a1b2c3d..deadbeef` shows kv_cache.py and model_loader changes — narrowing down repro.

alice.chen: thanks all. I'll follow up with a short postmortem and propose a safer rollout for the next attempt.

deploybot: summary: rollback completed, tag pinned, RB-4591 tracking, logs at https://deploys.redwood/2323456789/logs, follow-up owner raj.patel.
